tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: The page behind the shell and the sign-in screens (gray-100 / gray-900).

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces on canvas: the sidebar, the header, cards, dialogs, menus and the sign-in card (white / gray-800).

tokens.name: tile
tokens.usage: Quiet fills inside a panel: table header rows, hover rows, code and JSON blocks, the queued badge (gray-50 / gray-700).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Dividers and the edges of cards and dialogs (gray-200 / gray-700, drawn at 60% in dark). Never the edge of a control: that is control-border.

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: The edge of inputs, selects, textareas, checkboxes and radios (gray-500), 3:1 or better on canvas and panel. Decided 2026-11-27 (mockups/261127-form-contrast, 1B).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on canvas, panel and tile: headings, values, entry text, data (gray-800 / gray-100).

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text on an ink fill: the info toast.

tokens.name: ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Labels, descriptions, metadata and dates on canvas, panel and tile (gray-600 / the custom gray-300). The project aims at about 7:1 (webapp/docs/architecture.md); measured 6.9 to 7.6:1 in light, 5.9 to 10.1:1 in dark. Nothing lighter is used for text people must read.

tokens.name: error-ink
tokens.usage: Error text on panel, canvas and error-surface, always with words that say what to do (red-800 / red-400). Decided 2026-11-27 (mockups/261127-form-contrast, 2B).

tokens.name: error-surface
tokens.usage: The fill of an error alert (red-50 / red-900 at 20% on panel). Error-ink sits on it.

tokens.name: error-line
tokens.usage: The edge of an error alert (red-200 / red-700 at 60% on panel). Decorative: the words carry the meaning.

tokens.name: success-ink
tokens.usage: Text that says something worked: the Succeeded badge, saved confirmations (emerald-700 / emerald-300). Means success only; never decoration.

tokens.name: success-surface
tokens.usage: The fill behind success-ink in badges (emerald-100 / emerald-500 at 20% on panel).

tokens.name: warning-ink
tokens.usage: Warning text, such as "Your session has expired" (yellow-700 / yellow-400). Known miss: 2.6:1 on warning-surface in light, kept as today's look; dark passes at 9.0:1.

tokens.name: warning-surface
tokens.usage: The fill of a warning alert (yellow-50 / yellow-900 at 20% on panel).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The fill of primary buttons, the active tab's underline, unread badges, checked checkboxes and switches (accent-500). Shown in violet, the default; each user picks the accent (violet, green, emerald, blue, rose, graphite) and the app reads the scale from webapp/src/assets/accents.css.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: A primary button's hover fill (accent-600).

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on an accent fill. Known miss on violet, 3.7:1, kept by the owner's choice (2026-11-26); every other accent carries it at 4.5:1 or better.

tokens.name: accent-fg
tokens.usage: Accent foregrounds with no dark variant of their own: links, spinners, the focus ring, a focused input's border. 500 in light; in dark 500 for violet and 400 for the darker accents. Known miss on violet links, 3.7:1 on panel in light, kept by the owner's choice.

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: A soft accent fill: the running badge, selected chips (accent-100 / accent-500 at 20% on panel).

tokens.name: accent-tint-ink
tokens.usage: Text on accent-tint (accent-700 / accent-300).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The keyboard focus ring: a solid 2px outline at a 2px offset on every :focus-visible element. It is accent-fg, so it follows the user's accent; violet shown. Decided 2026-11-27 (mockups/261127-form-contrast, 3B).

styles.name: title-2
styles.usage: A section or card title (text-lg font-semibold).

styles.name: title-3
styles.usage: A dialog title, a small card's title (text-base font-semibold).

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Running text, table cells, inputs on a wide screen (text-sm).

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels, buttons, tabs, nav items (text-sm font-medium).

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Timestamps, badges, hints, chart axes (text-xs). Never below 12px.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: A label above its field; icon to text in a badge.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside a control; between buttons in a row.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Alert padding (vertical); between related items.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Between fields in a form; page gutter on a phone; alert padding (horizontal).

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card and dialog padding (p-5).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: The sign-in card's padding on a phone; above a form's button.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between sections; page gutter on a desktop; the sign-in card's padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Checkboxes, small tags (rounded).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs, buttons, alerts, toasts, nav items (rounded-lg).

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and dialogs (rounded-xl).

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: The sign-in card and the sidebar's rounded edge (rounded-2xl).

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Badges, pills, swatches, switches, avatars (rounded-full).

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Cards and the sign-in card (shadow-sm, the Mosaic value).

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs and toasts, which float over the page (shadow-lg).
